race.comment: DAISYDOO (5) went back from a wide draw last time but came with a huge run to score. Much better gate, drops in weight with the claim and building a great record this course and distance. Looks hard to beat again. RICHE D'AMOUR (6) found the line nicely to grab third last time out over 1000m at Morphettville Parks. Racing well and is among the leading chances.  VEXATIOUS DANCER (8) finished third last time over 1000m at Morphettville Parks, beaten 1.4 lengths. Rates highly and should feature. LEADING IMPACT (10) is hard to fault aiming for a winning hat-trick. Course and distance winner last time and can measure up again. BOUNCING BEYOND (9) has been about the mark of late. Last time out wasn't far away in fifth over 1250m at Morphettville Parks. Senior rider goes aboard and in the mix.
